reasons.plausibility: Adding 50 at.% Pt to FeCoNi is unlikely to produce a single-phase L1₀ structure in a high-entropy alloy context; such a high Pt content would likely form a mixture of fcc and Pt-rich phases, and the mechanism linking chemical short-range order to L1₀ ordering is not well-supported.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and includes a specific falsification criterion based on XRD and coercivity measurements, though the 200% increase threshold is somewhat arbitrary.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis addresses the core question of overcoming the coercivity limitation, but the proposed intervention (50 at.% Pt) is extreme and unlikely to be practical or successful, limiting its value to researchers.
